model.name: traceTree.autoExpandOnNavigate
model.description: R34.5 (R-D1, Tron IMG_4819 refined 2026-08-02: auto-expand polish, NOT a nav regression). RIDES the built R33.7.4 reveal mechanism (Method RbTraceTree.onTreeReveal 152435d1 -> Impl 9cdf5072: rb-tree-reveal listener -> revealNode ancestor-walk expand + scrollIntoView, R33.5 expandPath). GAP: the select->navigate case (selecting a class/element from a diagram/detail to NAVIGATE) does NOT dispatch rb-tree-reveal{ref}, so the folder ancestor path is not auto-expanded (nav itself is correct). FIX = wire the missing trigger to dispatch rb-tree-reveal / call revealModelElement on select->navigate — REUSE R33.7.4 wholesale, NO fork, NO new verb/Method (trigger is a call-site, rides Impl 9cdf5072). Client-only.
